text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One winter's eve, I hear the soft sound
of wind
blowing outside.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...That's the sound of the breeze that
bristles the
pine needles. Another sign
that winter is upon us.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The frosty gales might feel nice on our
skin. Shall
we go outside and see?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although it looks a little cold out, I can't
refuse
an invitation from Yamanin
Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Outside, my breath is visible as white
mist. I can't
help feeling invigorated by
the cold!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This boreal wind... Ngh. It truly feels like
it's
piercing my skin.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The bleakness of winter is spreading
here, too... It
feels like a blizzard could
begin any moment.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Oh. Can you hear that, Trainer? It's the
breath
of revelry, echoing out of season.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's the sound of the Squiggly
Horns
carrying giving gusts.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
They must be pulling a certain
someone's sleigh
through the night sky,
bringing joy to children
everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they can brave this cold... But
let's hope
they're blessed by the still of
spring all the same.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right. They have thick fur
coats and
are very tough animals.
choice_data_list: Reindeer are used to the cold, so you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I imagine they could overcome even a
piercingly
sharp headwind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I could learn from their strength—rather
than
simply shrinking in the face of the
piteraqs from
on high, I should boldly
brave the gale.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The strength to best the headwind... As
her
trainer, I intend to lend her my full
support so she
can acquire—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Did you catch a cold?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Even a storm would be a tender
breeze to
you, wouldn't it?
choice_data_list: I just got a little chilled, so I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well, you'd better stay warm and well.
That way,
you'll happen upon a breath
of fresh air.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr takes out a scarf. Its
bright and
festive colors are vivid in the
evening darkness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She carefully wraps the scarf once, then
twice
around my neck. Even through the
thick scarf, I
can feel her compassion.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It suits you like a snowstorm in
winter.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps it'd be more fitting to say...
you look
snug as a Squiggly Horn.
Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
See how the scarf is all fluffy and warm
around
your chest? Hehe, it looks good
on you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Consider it a giving gust, from me to
you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The icy wind is unforgiving, but it can
also give
way to a benison breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Please use that scarf when the winds
ahead grow
fierce. If you don't mind
wearing it, that is...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It looks like a radiant breeze has
touched you...
I'm glad.
choice_data_list: Yeah. It's so warm, I can't bring myself to take it off.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I expected the gales to be frosty,
but
thinking back, there was a still
serenity outside.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no... It's just... the early evening
breeze is
dying down.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Shall we still ourselves before we turn
into a
pair of icicles?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Let's enjoy tomorrow's winds
tomorrow.
choice_data_list: Let's go feel the breeze somewhere again.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well then, have a nice evening. Good
night.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Sigh... The early evening breeze is so comfort—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Excuse me. It seems the devil's
breath is
making mischief.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you sure? That's such an
auspicious
updraft...
choice_data_list: Shall we buy a scarf for you too?
Let's buy a scarf for you, too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...All right, I'll take you up on that offer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The shops and city streets are bustling
with
people. Come to think of it, I'm
pretty sure
Yamanin Zephyr struggles
with crowds.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
How like you—always a comforting
breeze.
choice_data_list: I can go buy some for you, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
However... the winds that follow the still
have
already begun to brush my
cheeks...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I have to overcome the cold currents.
We both
do, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr walks so close that our
shoulders
almost touch. I match her pace
so we don't get
separated as we make
our way to the store.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We push on through the crowds. After
finally
reaching our destination, we
spend some time
picking out a nice scarf
together.
